title: Saigon Skyline Chess
summary: An orthodox chess set designed for upright, support-free slicing whose full piece hierarchy is shaped by six architectural icons of Ho Chi Minh City and remains legible in one filament.

rules.board: 8 × 8 equal-square grid; near-right corner is the low-relief square

piece_mapping.king: Landmark 81 — bundled setbacks and highest spire
piece_mapping.queen: Bitexco Financial Tower — tapered tower and projecting sky deck
piece_mapping.bishop: Notre-Dame Cathedral Basilica of Saigon — paired towers and twin spires
piece_mapping.knight: Independence Palace — directional modernist slab and entry canopy
piece_mapping.rook: Bến Thành Market — broad hall, clock tower, and roof finial
piece_mapping.pawn: Saigon Central Post Office — long hall, arched roof, and clock cupola

limitations: The landmarks are original low-detail silhouette interpretations, not measured architectural replicas.
Fine façade ornament, text, and clock numerals are intentionally omitted at chess-piece scale.
Digital checks do not prove a successful physical print, durability, or human handling response.
No storage case is included in this Make revision; pieces require a separate padded container for transport.

source_notes.claim: FIDE defines an 8 × 8 board, sixteen pieces per side, and the orthodox initial position.
Official HCMC tourism materials identify Bến Thành Market's clock tower and list the Central Post Office, Opera House, Cathedral, Independence Palace, and Bến Thành Market as city landmarks.
Official HCMC tourism describes Landmark 81 as a bamboo-bundle-inspired city icon.
Bitexco's project material identifies the tower as a Ho Chi Minh City landmark; its projecting helipad is the distinguishing silhouette used here.

rights_and_attribution: Orthodox chess rules are preserved and attributed to FIDE as the current rules reference. Geometry is original parametric work inspired by publicly visible architectural silhouettes; no logos, marks, façade artwork, or copied commercial chess-piece designs are included.
